name: E-Finance Investment Group
source: E-Finance for Digital and Financial Investments Company S.A.E, audited separate financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, read from the signed filing on the issuer investor relations host
note: Company-level separate audited statements, not the consolidated group accounts. Amounts as printed in Egyptian pounds. The statement of financial position page in the filing is a scan; every total here was cross-checked against the filed statement of changes in equity and the filed statement of cash flows, and non current plus current assets equal total assets and total liabilities plus total equity equal total assets exactly in both years.
